assertions.description: 车载端的会话经协议故障代理建立（否则丢 ack 注入不到这条链路上）
丢掉的是一份服务端已经收下的装货结果：ProtocolInbox 有这一行，装货已 Committed
车重连后在新会话里以原 messageId 补发 OperationResult、sessionGeneration 换成新的，服务端按首次受理重签 DurableAck（control-server#77）
assertions.expected: same messageId replayed at a newer generation and acknowledged
assertions.actual: first on #1 at generation 1; 1 replay(s), first on #2 at generation 2; acked on a later connection 1 time(s)

assertions.description: 补发之后同一条连接照常走完握手：Hello → Accepted → 补发 → 其 ack → 能力快照 → 安全快照 → 新 messageId 的 RecoveryStateReport → SessionReadiness；旧的恢复报告一条都不按原编号补发（onboard-hmi#69，CV-SESSION-RECONNECT-DURING-RECOVERY）
assertions.expected: 按序 / 新报告 >= 1 / 旧报告补发 0
assertions.actual: #2 onboard->server:SessionHello server->onboard:SessionAccepted onboard->server:OperationResult server->onboard:DurableAck onboard->server:CapabilitySnapshot server->onboard:SnapshotAppliedAck onboard->server:SafetyStateSnapshot server->onboard:SnapshotAppliedAck onboard->server:OnboardAlarmSnapshot server->onboard:SnapshotAppliedAck onboard->server:RecoveryStateReport server->onboard:DurableAck server->onboard:SessionReadiness onboard->server:SafetyStateChanged onboard->server:OnboardAlarmSnapshot server->onboard:DurableAck server->onboard:SessionReadiness server->onboard:SnapshotAppliedAck server->onboard:SlotOperationCommand / 新报告 1 / 旧报告补发 0

assertions.description: 服务端在新世代把会话判回 Ready：本代次能力快照、安全快照与恢复状态报告齐全
补发被确认之后旅程照常走完
装货结果只记了一次，卸货 Committed，需求 Succeeded
补发之后没有哪条连接被服务端掐掉：丢 ack 之后的连接要么车自己关的、要么到收尾还开着
assertions.expected: 0 connections after the drop ended by anyone but the onboard
assertions.actual: 0 (#1: relay dropped DurableAck for OperationResult; #2: open)

assertions.description: 丢一次 ack 只换来一次重连：之后只有一条连接，而且到收尾还开着
assertions.actual: 2 connections, 1 open (#1: relay dropped DurableAck for OperationResult; #2: open)
